get_cfg_defaults: get a clone of the default pyrobot CfgNode configuration tree with arm, camera, base, and gripper settings
configure_ARM_class: set the ARM.CLASS config value to choose a robot arm implementation like LoCoBotArm
configure_ARM_ik_tolerance: set ARM.IK_POSITION_TOLERANCE and ARM.IK_ORIENTATION_TOLERANCE to adjust inverse kinematics precision
configure_ARM_ee_error: set ARM.MAX_EE_ERROR to control the maximum allowed end-effector position error
configure_robot_hardware_flags: set HAS_ARM, HAS_BASE, HAS_CAMERA, HAS_GRIPPER flags to enable or disable robot components
